metadata.title: Technology Capability Delivery Channels
metadata.description: Proposed configured workspaces and human service touchpoints. No production vendor, hosting, or interface claim.

channels.description: Logical configured workspace boundaries with company, fund, coaching, and candidate isolation. Hosting and provider choices remain unverified.
Proposed configured tools, forms, and controlled imports/exports; not an observed deployment or an instruction to build 26 services.
